title: Lighthouse retail on-prem scratchpad
content:
Context: Lighthouse (large retail customer) — POC for private deployment inside their colocation. Goal: bring up a 3-node GPU cluster, run Redwood Private control plane (customer-managed) + serving tier for 1-2 models. Work in progress; this is my daily scratchpad for action items, quick config notes, and troubleshooting logs.

2024-11-15 — initial scoping
- customer constraints: air-gapped 'greenfield' colo; strict egress policy; HSM for keys; internal CA only.
- capacity ask: 3x A100 equiv nodes for initial POC, will scale after latency checks.
- model sizes: 13B for chat, 7B for embeddings (quantized versions planned).
- SLO: p50 < 80ms token for short prompts (chat-lite), p95 < 300ms for full flows.

Quick checklist (high-level)
- [ ] finalize network diagram + NAT plan with customer networking
- [x] define node sizing and GPU drivers (Aisha verified CUDA / driver matrix)
- [ ] HSM/KMS key exchange process (Marcus follow-up)
- [ ] image registry access: set up ephemeral mirror inside colo
- [ ] test KV cache correctness & startup warmup pipeline

Commands I used (note: run as deploy user)
- kubectl apply -f namespaces.yaml -n redwood-private
- helm upgrade --install redwood-control-plane ./charts/control-plane -f values-lighthouse.yaml --namespace redwood-private
- docker pull ghcr.io/redwood-inference/serve:2024-11-12 && docker tag ... (mirror to internal registry)

Helm values notes (values-lighthouse.yaml snippets)
- replicas.serving: 3
- nodeSelector: { "gpu-type": "a100" }
- tolerations: [{ key: "nvidia.com/gpu", operator: "Exists" }]
- registry: "internal-registry.lighthouse.corp:5000/rw"
- modelStore: s3://lighthouse-models (via s3-gateway)
- kms: { type: "hsm", endpoint: "10.0.12.3:8443", keyAlias: "lgh-root" }

Config gotchas discovered
- internal CA requires certs in PEM chain order; kubelet failed until CA chain fixed.
- customer NTP drift was >15s, caused TLS handshake failures for control-plane -> metrics collector. Add step to check /etc/chrony before install.
- GPU driver mismatch: nodes had driver 515.x, need at least 525 for nvml features used by our monitoring. Added to preflight.

Preflight checklist (to automate)
- [ ] curl control-plane healthz from bastion (should return 200 within 2s)
- [ ] validate /proc/driver/nvidia/version >= 525
- [ ] pull-signed-images.sh to mirror images into internal registry
- [ ] ensure route to HSM endpoint and firewall rule allow 8443 from control-plane nodes

Canary / Rollout plan (minimal risk)
1) Deploy control-plane + 1 serving replica in staging namespace 'redwood-lgh-stage'
2) Smoke tests: generation, embeddings, streaming responses, KV cache warmup. Test prompt set: /tests/lighthouse/smoke-suite.yaml (10 prompts)
3) If smoke green, scale to 3 replicas and enable LB for internal traffic.
4) Monitor cost/latency for 4h, then promote to 'production' namespace.

Troubleshooting log (11/17)
- symptom: model downloads failing intermittently (403). Root cause: presigned URLs generated with wrong region header by s3-gateway config. Patch: add X-Amz-Region config to gateway; PR submitted (rw-deploy#482).
- symptom: segmentation fault in server process after 2000 concurrent tokens. Repro: load-test with wrk + custom token generator. Found that shared mem config default (shmSize=64m) too small for KV cache on 13B model. Bumped to 512m in values.

Open questions / TODOs
- Does customer want audit logs forwarded outside the colo? (likely no) -> affects how much telemetry we keep local.
- Confirm retention policy for logs (security team probably wants 1y).
- Need signed NDA appendix for HSM access procedure (legal loop).
- Which internal DNS name do they prefer for the controlplane LB? px-control.lighthouse.corp vs cp.lighthouse.internal. I prefer short.

Short-term action items (next 48h)
- Diego: finish preflight script and post in #lighthouse-eng (ETA: 11/18)
- Aisha: test quantized 7B embeddings under local mirror; send perf numbers (ETA: 11/18)
- Marcus: confirm HSM certificate provisioning steps with customer security (ETA: 11/19)
- Book 1h sync with customer infra to walk through NAT & routing (use this checklist)

Notes-to-self (handy snippets)
- kubelet check: ssh node 'cat /proc/driver/nvidia/version'
- mirror command: regctl image copy ghcr.io/... internal-registry:5000/...
- env var for serve: RW_MODEL_CACHE_MAX=12GB, RW_PREFETCH_WORKERS=4
- local profile for debugging: ./scripts/dev-shell --profile lighthouse --attach-logs

End-of-day thoughts
- Prioritize the preflight automation. We waste a lot of time on manual driver/cert fixes on POC installs. Aim to have a 1-command preflight that returns clear PASS/FAIL with remediation hints.
- Keep rollout conservative; customer is sensitive to any downtime during Black Friday window. We need explicit blackout dates in contract.

Last updated by Diego Ramos 2024-11-20 09:12

References / links (quick)
- Jira: LGH-231 (POC network + infra)
- PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/rw-deploy/pull/482 (s3-gateway region fix)
- Slack: #lighthouse-eng (pinned: preflight script, smoke-suite)
